# Contributing

Every file here is generated from the tips at copybook.page, so a change made in this repository, by hand or by pull request, is overwritten on the next sync. Open an issue instead; the fix lands in the next sync, with you credited in the commit.

- **A tip stopped working:** open "Tip stopped working". Say which tip, which agent and model, and what happened. It goes into the weekly check.
- **Suggest a tip:** open "Suggest a tip" with a link. Copybook takes tips from the posts readers saved most on X, and [@Voxyz_ai](https://x.com/Voxyz_ai) decides what goes in.
